facts.business: CMS Info Systems is India's leading unified Business Services Platform operating across 97% of India's geography, managing cash replenishment and reconciliation across 70,000+ ATMs, servicing over 65,000 retail touchpoints, operating approximately 1,400 currency-in-transit routes across 20,000 bank branches, monitoring over 50,000 sites in real time through its HAWKAI Vision AI platform, and powering ATM software on 65,000 machines through its ALGO MVS platform, processing approximately Rs 14 lakh Cr through its network annually.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Management targets EBITDA margins to return to 26%+ in FY27
FSS Managed Services acquisition expected to contribute approximately 4% to FY27 services revenue
Pipeline of 6,000 to 8,000 ATM units in active RFP stages

key_risks: AGS disruption causing near-term revenue and margin pressure
Competitor exit leading to market consolidation but near-term capital pressure on smaller providers
Private banks cutting ATM sites and delaying payments
Outsourced ATM base contraction from 140,000 to 120,000 machines
Wage and fuel inflation impacting costs
Lower network utilization in H1 FY26
One-time investment in new delivery models
Transaction-linked contract bids avoided leading to lower short-term revenue
